verdicts.reason: A makes a sensible two-column banner: the logo strip is slimmed, the headline block sits on the left and the CTA on the right. Its flaws are the orange divider, which is pushed to the left edge under a centred text column, and a large empty band below the body copy that makes the layout feel top-heavy. B keeps an oversized white logo header that takes about a quarter of the height and drops the divider. Its eyebrow is centred on the canvas rather than over the headline, and the body copy is centred on a different axis than the headline. On top of that, the body copy is cramped toward the bottom edge, and 'Ships late June' is right-aligned rather than sitting under the button, so the alignment looks arbitrary throughout.
